subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that V/STOL vertical landing is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.1.6 Vertical landing (VL). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities for VLs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of all VLs to evaluate air vehicle capabilities and control margins, to include: a. Vertical landing to pad. b. Ship VL. c. Vertical landing to hover pit. d. Creeping VL if applicable. e. Baseline control system. f. Precision hover modes. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Vertical Landing (VL) paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Vertical landing to pad. b. Ship VL. c. Vertical landing to hover pit. d. Creeping VL if applicable. e. Baseline control system. f. Precision hover modes. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Vertical Landing (VL) paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Vertical landing to pad. b. Ship VL. c. Vertical landing to hover pit. d. Creeping VL if applicable. e. Baseline control system. f. Precision hover modes.
